name: harness-config
description: Configuration health for a repo's Claude Code: audit (settings, .mcp.json, hooks, plugins, permission drift), audit-automation-gaps, audit-permission-grants, audit-permission-state (effective rules with provenance), draft-auto-mode-rules (prints an autoMode block), audit-instructions (instructions the model no longer needs, conflicts), audit-prompting-postures, audit-pass (one ordered, resumable pass), unhobble (strip instructions, re-add what evidence earns), and setup.

time_units.title: Time units in estimates
time_units.description: When on, /harness-config:audit-automation-gaps may state the size of an implementation plan in minutes, hours, days or weeks; when off it gives a relative size (Small, Medium, Large) instead. A time budget you state is kept in your words either way. Default: off.
